EmailTemplate.subject: Two-factor authentication now available
EmailTemplate.textOnly: Protect your Flywire account with two-factor authentication Flywire works hard to maintain the highest level of security to protect our clients and your data. Now you can keep your account extra secure with a second authentication step. Watch this short video <[[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sbBJmXAX4Zs]]>to see how easy it is to set up two-factor authentication on your account. Learn More If you have any questions about two-factor authentication, including how you can require this to be enabled for all users on your account, contact your Relationship Manager or simply reply to this email.
